subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off `channels.feishu.sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target Feishu outbound pacing?
rationale: The implementation is plugin-local and plausible, but accepting a new documented operator-facing Feishu config key and the proof bar for live send timing requires maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased equivalent once real Feishu proof is added or explicitly overridden.

options.title: Keep Reactive Retry Only
options.body: Reject the new config surface and rely on the already-merged Feishu retry/backoff behavior after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Defer To Broad Limiter
options.body: Pause this PR and make the broad external API rate-limiting issue own any cross-provider queueing policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased equivalent once real Feishu proof is added or explicitly overridden.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
